questions.q:
Such was the education/of the Spartans with regard to/one of the greatest of there kings.

(SSC CHSL Tier-01 21/03/23)
o: One of the greatest of there kings
questions.s:
The correct answer is Option 2: One of the greatest of there kings.

"there" is a possessive determiner (used to show possession), but here it should be "their", which is the correct possessive form to indicate ownership (referring to the kings belonging to the Spartans).

"There" is typically used to refer to a place or location (e.g., over there), but in this sentence, "their" is required.

Correct sentence: Such was the education of the Spartans with regard to one of the greatest of their kings.

questions.q:

o: who live in Pune
questions.s:
Correct Answer: who live in Pune

  • The correct verb should be "lives" for singular subject "brother."

  • Corrected Sentence: My brother who lives in Pune is arriving tomorrow.

questions.q: Q6. Q6. Children can injure himself (a)/in the blink of an eye so the parents (b)/should always be cautious. (c) /No error.(d)

questions.q:

[CGL Mains 28/01/2022]
questions.s:
Correct Answer: No improvement required

"It is I who am responsible" is grammatically correct because:

"I" is the correct subjective case after the linking verb "is."

"Am" agrees with "I" in the present tense.

"Who" correctly introduces the relative clause referring to "I."

questions.q: Payal as well as her friends was / absented themselves / from the class because / it was the day of 'Bihar-band'.
o: Payal as well as her friends was
questions.s:
Explanation:- Absent do kaam karta hai verb banna ya adjective banna jab yeh verb banta hai toh apne sath Reflexive Pronoun rakhta hai but is sentence ka structure thoda complex hai yahan (a) part me was diya gya hai aur (b) part me absented likha gya hai agar hum ise passive maane toh bhi passive ke andar object nahi hota hai isliye themselves drop hoga leking yahan passive ka koi sense nahi hai isliye passive manna bhi sahi nahi hoga toh sabse best options yahan pr yeh kiya ja sakta hai ki absented ko kaat kar absent likh de jisse veh adjective ban jayega aur adjective ke sath reflexive pronoun nahi aata hai toh themselves ko drop kar diya jayega. Yaani sahi sentence hoga Payal as well as her friends was absent from the class.

Note:- as well as yahan koi simile nahi hai yeh ek Prepositional phrase hai isliye verb Payal ke according aayegi jo ki was likhi gayi hai jo ki sahi hai.

questions.q: Q14. Q74. <u>A hole is</u> in my pocket.
